verdict.rationale: Typesense's ranking-and-relevance guide has sections on 'Boosting / Burying sets of records' and 'Promoting or Hiding Results (Merchandising)', and a curation API page exists, which covers the pin/boost/hide part of the story. However, the evidence is section headings only, and nothing in the pack mentions synonym definition. missing for 10: any evidence of synonym support, detailed docs on per-query pin/hide rules, independent or hands-on corroboration of curation.
